### problem_chain
Walk from the root (the customer asks only to finish the cancellation and know the refund):
- Root: kept-vehicle refund (customer_request request). Its rule carries two prerequisite sentences:
  - "fixed only after the records carry a paid component-repair line for every claim line the contract denied for the waiting period while it was sold on its vehicle's purchase deal" — false at opening: vsc_ledger has CLM-4471208 waiting_period denied, purchase_deal_id filled, and no vsc_claim_paid row at all. The policy whose rule pays such a line back: waiting re-decision. Kind value_input (fee tier, below).
  - "not computed until every claim whose repair order supported a Kessler loaner, and whose component-repair line the contract has paid or has denied for the waiting period while it was sold on its vehicle's purchase deal, carries its paid rental line" — false at opening: loaner_agreements LA-448312 repair_order_number RO 446215 = the denied claim's RO, no rental line. Resolver: rental policy. Kind state_gate.
- Rental's rule: "A rental line is booked only after the records carry a paid component-repair line under the same claim number." — false at opening (same row evidence). Resolver: waiting re-decision.
- Waiting re-decision: no prerequisite sentence; its own scope holds now (denied for waiting period although sold on the deal; RO 446215 lines are customer_pay and paid 1952.62).
- Derived tree: waiting -> rental (state_gate), waiting -> kept (value_input), rental -> kept (state_gate). Prerequisite problems n = 2, value_input edges 1 ≥ max(1,1). Customer's own write: the root (`accept_kept_vehicle_cancellation_d270783c`, owner user). Acyclic. Topological order: waiting, rental, kept.
- Load-bearing: skip waiting -> rental computes 0.00 (no paid component line on any claim) and kept's fee is 25.00 (3755.75 instead of 3780.75); skip rental -> kept's value unchanged (3780.75) but the state gate is unmet and the rental line is missing from the terminal state (gate-only edge, admitted by the max(n−1,1) floor).
- Parallel edges: none share a balance that orders them differently; the only shared quantity is claims paid (limit 40000 not approached).
- No waiting: all three resolving actions are desk writes on recorded facts.
- Tools judge nothing: the three function bodies create/update rows unconditionally (task_tools.py).
- Isomorphic to the declared `prerequisite` graph (`_difficulty.md` § prerequisite_graph).
